title: Weaken infinite field to |K| > n for cyclic vectors

currentState.focus: Created proof skeleton with key lemmas identified.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Created CayleyHamiltonMinpolyOQ05OQ01OQ01.lean with proof skeleton (3 sorries). Key insight: replace [Infinite K] with |K| > n. Identified 3 needed lemmas: (1) #irreducible factors ≤ degree, (2) finite union avoidance with cardinality bound, (3) main theorem assembly.
insights: The infinite field hypothesis is only needed in union avoidance
Union avoidance over k subspaces needs |K| > k
Number of irreducible factors of degree-n polynomial ≤ n (each factor has degree ≥ 1)
So |K| > n suffices for the nonderogatory cyclic vector theorem
The proof architecture is modular: replace one lemma, keep the rest
